body:
I love to pop pills, maybe a little too much.  The problem is that I usually cant get them but the day this event happened was different.  A friend of mine hooked me up with a friend of his.  We met and he dumped a bottle filled with a colorful variety of pills. At the time I was buying 10 xanaxs and 4 loracets.  So I we worked out a price and he told me he had some MS contin too.  I wasnt really wanting any but he told me he'd through me a 60 for 15 so I said fuck and bought it.  I got home at around 8 o clock and immediataly popped 2 blue 1 milli xanaxs and chopped the OC up. I dont know if it was the brand or if I used too much spit to clean off the coating but the pill was sort of damp but I still sniffed away a quarter of it.  15 minuted later I didnt feel it so I sniffed another quarter, 15 minutes later I didnt feel it.
At this point I thought I had been burned, so I looked the pill up on rx and the list was so fucking big I couldnt find it and I gave up with about two listings to go.  To make a long story short I polished of the pill and began to watch pulp fiction.  Out of the blue I  started feeling nausious, but warm and care free.  I thought to my self , damn this pill might be real.
I woke up the next day at 8 o clock in the after noon.  I was probaly a hair away from being in a godamn coma.  Watch out pharmaceuticals arent anything to fuck with, be careful, very very careful.
